start: A gym member: no MettleUp account signed in; has just finished a third own workout (demo workouts not counted)

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: Card: 'Your workouts are only on this phone. Sign in with Google and MettleUp keeps them safe in your account.'
Links: 'Sign in to keep them safe' and 'Hide for 30 days'
must_not: The card after only two own workouts
Two notice cards at once

steps.action: Tap 'Sign in to keep them safe'
must_not: The page opening twice on a double tap
A sign-in starting by itself

steps.action: Sign in there, go back to the Workout tab
must_not: The card still showing to a signed-in member

start: A gym member: no account; fewer than three own workouts, or only the demo workouts, or a build that cannot sign in

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
must_not: The card counting demo workouts
A sign-in link on a build where sign-in does not exist

steps.action: Open the Workout tab when the workout count cannot be read
must_not: An error or a card with a wrong claim

start: A gym member: no account; three or more own workouts; card showing

steps.action: Tap 'Hide for 30 days'
must_not: The card staying until the next visit

steps.action: Close and open the app the next day
must_not: The card back before 30 days

steps.action: Open the Workout tab 30 days later, still not signed in
must_not: The card hidden for ever after one Hide

steps.action: Sign in, then sign out again
user_sees: Signed in: no card. Signed out: the card returns
must_not: A signed-out member left with no warning that workouts are on this phone only

start: A gym member: no account; three own workouts; has joined a gym

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: 'Your workouts are only on this phone.'
must_not: These words when a copy of the workouts already sits somewhere else (an old Drive backup, a gym summary, gym mates)

steps.action: Tap 'Hide for 30 days' and carry on with no account
must_not: Any workout sent to a MettleUp account without a sign-in
